Normalization: Native SDK and signed raw responses; only issued upload IDs and SSE-C ETags rebound. Body digests computed from consumed native response bytes. Request body recipes are not response expectations. SDK read projections omit times, owner IDs, request metadata. Raw steps retain header absence and selection. SSE-C completed ETags are issued ciphertext identities and rebound at completion, with subsequent retained-read equality preserved. GetObjectAttributes composite checksums omit the multipart suffix; GetObject PartNumber returns the selected part digest. ListParts and GetObjectAttributes.ObjectParts PartNumberMarker/NextPartNumberMarker are normalized from boto3 integer representations to Go SDK modeled strings. Observation84 replays the observed InvalidPart error code without a Status assertion: original wire status was not captured and an embedded-200 completion error may have been rewritten by botocore to its recorded status500; replay does not infer framing from that exception. Independently observed SHA512 per-part XML InvalidPart400 remains replayed at observation195. Each scenario preserves one captured bucket lifetime; duplicated creation prerequisites are removed without dropping consumer calls. All calls from a capture use TLS when customer-key operations require it.
